title: XZ Utils Backdoor Supply Chain Compromise
text: CVE-2024-3094 (MITRE ATT&CK T1195.002 Supply Chain Compromise): Malicious backdoor injected into upstream xz/liblzma versions 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 affecting Linux distributions with systemd-linked OpenSSH. Enables pre-authentication remote code execution via crafted Ed448 signatures. Remediation: Downgrade xz-utils/liblzma to uncompromised 5.4.x builds immediately, audit SSH exposure, and rotate host keys.

title: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
text: CVE-2024-21762 (CISA KEV, MITRE ATT&CK T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application): Critical out-of-bounds write in FortiOS SSL VPN allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via specially crafted HTTP requests. Remediation: Upgrade FortiOS to patched releases (7.4.3+, 7.2.7+, 7.0.14+), disable SSL VPN if unused, and inspect firewall logs for anomalous outbound connections.

title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Distributed Denial of Service
text: CVE-2023-44487 (CISA KEV, MITRE ATT&CK T1499.004 Application or System Exploitation): Protocol-level Denial of Service exploiting HTTP/2 stream multiplexing and RST_STREAM frames to exhaust server resources without triggering standard concurrent stream limits. Remediation: Apply vendor HTTP/2 server patches (Nginx, Envoy, Apache, IIS), enforce RST_STREAM rate limits, and deploy WAF/DDoS edge mitigation.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution Triage Playbook
text: MITRE ATT&CK T1059.001 (Execution — Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell): Obfuscated Base64 commands (-EncodedCommand), hidden windows (-WindowStyle Hidden), and download cradles (IEX / Net.WebClient) indicate active Execution stage activity. SOC Triage: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging (Event ID 4104) and Module Logging (4103), isolate affected endpoints, enforce Constrained Language Mode, and inspect parent process trees.

title: Scheduled Task Persistence Investigation Playbook
text: MITRE ATT&CK T1053.005 (Persistence — Scheduled Task/Job): Adversaries abuse schtasks.exe or Task Scheduler COM APIs to maintain Persistence across reboots by executing payloads from writable directories (AppData, Temp, Public). SOC Triage: Audit Windows Security Event ID 4698 and TaskScheduler Operational logs (Event ID 106), remove unauthorized XML task definitions under C:\Windows\System32\Tasks, and restrict task creation privileges.

title: LSASS Memory Dumping Credential Access Playbook
text: MITRE ATT&CK T1003.001 (Credential Access — OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory): Tools such as Mimikatz, ProcDump, or comsvcs.dll MiniDump access lsass.exe to harvest NTLM hashes and Kerberos tickets. SOC Triage: Monitor Sysmon Event ID 10 (ProcessAccess to lsass.exe), enable Credential Guard and RunAsPPL (LSASS Protected Process Light), isolate the host, and trigger immediate enterprise password/KRBTGT resets.

title: SMB Admin Share Lateral Movement Playbook
text: MITRE ATT&CK T1021.002 (Lateral Movement — Remote Services: SMB/Windows Admin Shares): Attackers traverse internal networks over TCP port 445 using ADMIN$, C$, or IPC$ shares via PsExec, Impacket smbexec, or WMI. SOC Triage: Correlate Windows Event IDs 4624 (Logon Type 3) and 5140 (Network Share Object Access), enforce SMB signing, segment workstation-to-workstation SMB traffic, and restrict local administrator reuse via LAPS.

title: Outbound C2 Indicator & Proxy Triage Playbook
text: MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001 (Command and Control — Application Layer Protocol): Suspicious external IPv4 indicators (including Tor exit nodes and uncategorized C2 infrastructure such as 185.220.101.4) observed in outbound proxy/firewall logs require immediate triage. SOC Triage: Query proxy/DNS logs for beaconing intervals and User-Agent anomalies, block the indicator at the perimeter firewall/proxy, isolate the internal source host, and capture volatile process/network state.
